title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON Data
description: This feature enables yantraverse to parse JSON data from request bodies, allowing for more flexible and efficient handling of API requests. It will improve performance by reducing the need for manual parsing and provide better support for modern web applications. This feature will also include error handling for invalid JSON data
testCases: Test JSON parsing with valid data
Test JSON parsing with invalid data
Test error handling for malformed JSON
acceptance: The feature is accepted when the framework can successfully parse JSON data from request bodies and handle errors for invalid data
reason: This feature is a key requirement for many modern web applications and will significantly improve the usability and performance of yantraverse
